entries.Original: You are currently in a PvP zone.
entries.Translated: 您当前处于 PvP 区域。

entries.Original: This plugin does not function in PvP.
entries.Translated: 该插件在 PvP 中不起作用。

entries.Original: Whether to draw any lines at all
Should a line be drawn connecting you to your target?
entries.Translated: 是否应该画一条线将您与目标连接起来？

entries.Original: If enabled, the tether will be drawn entirely on the same plane as your target, even if your height is different. This is recommended if you intend to limit the tether length.
entries.Translated: 如果启用，系绳将完全绘制在与目标相同的平面上，即使您的身高不同。如果您打算限制系绳长度，建议您这样做。

entries.Original: If you want to toggle the server info bar element, you will need to open Dalamud's settings (using the `/xlsettings` command) and uncheck it on the Server Info Bar tab.
entries.Translated: 如果您想切换服务器信息栏元素，则需要打开 Dalamud 的设置（使用“/xlsettings”命令）并在“服务器信息栏”选项卡上取消选中它。

entries.Original: Which guidelines do you want, and in what colours?
entries.Translated: 您想要哪些指南以及什么颜色？

entries.Original:
Some users have reported that lines being partially off-screen causes a visual bug, wherein the line just shoots off across your whole screen in a random direction. This setting will stop individual lines from being drawn if neither point is on the screen.

There may still be some weirdness in certain camera angles, but it should be much more limited.

The following two options only apply if this one is disabled.
entries.Translated:
一些用户报告说，线条部分脱离屏幕会导致视觉错误，其中线条只是以随机方向射出整个屏幕。如果屏幕上没有一点，此设置将停止绘制单独的线条。

某些拍摄角度可能仍然存在一些奇怪的地方，但应该受到更多限制。

仅当禁用此选项时，以下两个选项才适用。

entries.Original:
This setting will stop individual lines from being drawn if the inner point (the middle of the target's hitbox) isn't on your screen.

Only applies if the above override option is disabled.
entries.Translated:
如果内部点（目标命中框的中间）不在屏幕上，此设置将停止绘制单独的线条。

仅当上述覆盖选项被禁用时才适用。

entries.Original:
Much like the above, this setting stops lines from drawing if their endpoint (at/past the outside of the target's hitbox) isn't on your screen.

Only applies if the above override option is disabled.
entries.Translated:
与上面的非常相似，如果线条的端点（位于/超过目标命中框的外部）不在屏幕上，则此设置将停止绘制线条。

仅当上述覆盖选项被禁用时才适用。

entries.Original: This setting will cause the circle colours to be always the defined ones and disable the automatic colouring of the circle based on the guidelines.
entries.Translated: 此设置将使圆圈颜色始终为定义的颜色，并禁用根据指南自动为圆圈着色。

entries.Original: As above but only for the target circle.
entries.Translated: 如上所述，但仅适用于目标圆。

entries.Original: As above but only for the outer circle.
entries.Translated: 如上所述，但仅适用于外圆。

entries.Original: The positional guidelines normally extend from the target's centre point out to the size of their hitbox. This allows you to make them longer or shorter.
entries.Translated: 位置指南通常从目标的中心点延伸到其命中框的大小。这允许您使它们更长或更短。

entries.Original: Guidelines will always be drawn to at least this length, even if they would ordinarily have been smaller.
entries.Translated: 指导方针将始终至少绘制到这个长度，即使它们通常会更小。

entries.Original: Guidelines will never be longer than this, no matter how big the target's hitbox is.
entries.Translated: 无论目标的碰撞箱有多大，指南永远不会比这个长。

entries.Original: How wide/thick do you want the lines to be?
entries.Translated: 您希望线条有多宽/多粗？

entries.Original:
How big should the outer circle be?

Value is an offset to the target circle, and a value of 10 corresponds to 1 yalm.
A value of 35 very closely resembles the max melee range.
entries.Translated:
外圆应该有多大？

值是到目标圆的偏移量，值 10 对应于 1 yalm。
值 35 非常接近最大近战范围。

entries.Original:
The inner tether will never extend beyond the centre of the target's hitbox.

Set to -1 to always go to the centre of the target's hitbox.
entries.Translated:
内部系绳永远不会超出目标碰撞箱的中心。

设置为 -1 始终到达目标命中框的中心。

entries.Original:
The outer tether CAN extend beyond your hitbox.

Set to -1 to always go to the centre of the your hitbox.
Set to -2 to always go to the edge of your hitbox.
entries.Translated:
外部系绳可以延伸到碰撞箱之外。

设置为 -1 始终位于碰撞箱的中心。
设置为 -2 始终到达碰撞箱的边缘。

entries.Original: Most of the above toggle settings can be changed via command:
entries.Translated: 上面的大多数切换设置都可以通过命令更改：

entries.Original: Action may be any of the following:
entries.Translated: 操作可以是以下任意一种：

entries.Original: Target may be any of the following, hyphyens optional, to toggle that line:
entries.Translated: 目标可以是以下任何一个，连字符可选，以切换该行：

entries.Original: fl, front-left, f, front, fr, front-right, r, right, br, back-right, b, back, bl, back-left, l, left
entries.Translated: fl、左前、f、前、fr、右前、r、右、br、右后、b、后、bl、左后、l、左

entries.Original: For the target circle: c, circle, target-circle
For the outer circle: co, outer-circle, outer
Additionally, you can use 'cardinal', 'cardinals', 'diagonal', 'diagonals', 'lines', and 'all' to affect multiple lines with a single command.
entries.Translated: 此外，您可以使用“cardinal”、“cardinals”、“diagonal”、“diagonals”、“lines”和“all”通过单个命令影响多条线。

entries.Original: Finally, you can use the target 'tether' to toggle tether line rendering, and the target 'render' (the default) to toggle showing guides at all without losing your settings.
entries.Translated: 最后，您可以使用目标“系绳”来切换系绳线渲染，并使用目标“渲染”（默认）来切换显示指南，而不会丢失您的设置。
打开位置助手的配置窗口
